summary.intent: Work through two pending todos: (1) wire CTR encryption for media uploads through the SDK's uploadFile(), and (2) debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by identifying root causes and fixing the load test harness.
summary.outcome: Both features were implemented, PR #399 (CTR encryption) and PR #400 (BYO-IPFS fix + PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint) were created and iterated on through multiple review cycles. A third todo was captured to fix ESLint scanning Rust build artifacts.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts but was never called in the SDK upload path — new uploads always used GCM regardless of file size/type
setByoStatus() was a dead service method in the API with no controller endpoint wired up, meaning BYO mode could never actually be enabled via the API
The SDK test files used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> with module.get() which strips mock method types — a systemic pattern across ~9 API spec files causing TypeScript errors
pnpm api:generate writes openapi.json to the script's cwd (apps/api/) rather than packages/api-client/ unless run via the proper ts-node script path
The load test's ipns-publish step was sending {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record, metadataCid} — the signed IPNS record was missing entirely
target/ (Rust build artifacts) is not excluded from ESLint, causing 261 of 262 lint errors to come from generated Rust doc JS files
.husky/commit-msg and .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire should be added to .git/info/exclude rather than committed, since Entire CLI manages them locally
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts
The todo pending/done directory can get duplicate entries when a branch merges both copies (pending + done) of the same todo file

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and 'GCM' mode — needed optional encryptionMode param to dispatch to encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv for CTR
uploadFile() in SDK client needed to call selectEncryptionMode() before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile(), passing the resolved mode through
Centralized STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode(), and normalizeEncryptionMode() — previously duplicated between SDK client and web app
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added with SetByoStatusDto (enable: boolean) and SetByoStatusResponseDto — previously setByoStatus() was an orphaned service method
createByoClientPool() must call PATCH /vault/byo-status after account creation — accounts default to isByoUser=false causing all register-cid calls to 400/403

ipns-publish step sent wrong fields {ipnsName, cid} instead of signed IPNS record — replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord() from sdk-core; also createSdkContext() was being called per-iteration instead of hoisted outside the loop
mockRequest typed as Request & {user} wasn't assignable to RequestWithUser — needed explicit import and type cast; QuotaResponseDto mock was missing advisory field
vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core', () => ({...})) bare factory drops all real exports — 5 SDK test files needed migration to importOriginal spread pattern to survive new exports

workflow: When centralizing shared logic, check all consumers (SDK client, web app, load tests) — MIME type list was duplicated in 2 places and load test was a third consumer
After adding new exports to a package, all test files that mock that package with bare factory functions (not importOriginal spread) will break in CI
Committing specific files rather than git add -A on generated output (api-client/) will cause CI drift checks to fail — always stage the full generated directory
GraphQL GitHub API times out intermittently; fallback to REST for PR comment fetching works reliably
Running pnpm api:generate requires the API server to be running (it hits the live /api-json endpoint) — can't generate from a stale build

friction: api:generate wrote openapi.json to the wrong directory (apps/api/ instead of packages/api-client/) when invoked manually via node -e, causing a large spurious diff in the PR
sdk-core build output was stale during typecheck of the SDK package — had to rebuild sdk-core first before sdk typecheck would pass
GitHub GraphQL API timed out repeatedly for review thread fetching, requiring fallback to REST
Entire CLI modified .husky/commit-msg locally without excluding it from git tracking, causing the hook wrapper to appear as a modified file in every session
Pre-existing TypeScript errors in 9+ API spec files (jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern) had to be fixed before typecheck would pass — significant scope creep from the original task
CI caught missing api-client model files (admin/, migration/ directories) because only specific files were staged in the commit rather than the full generated src/ directory
Background task notifications arrived late, creating confusion about whether commits/pushes had completed
open_items: Add target/ to eslint.config.js ignores to eliminate 261 spurious lint errors from Rust build artifacts (todo captured: 2026-03-30-exclude-rust-target-directory-from-eslint.md)

Todos #7-12 (E2E test suites: AES-CTR streaming, batch download, media preview, deleteAccount teardown, BYO-IPFS load baselines, staging metrics baselines) were marked done but the underlying work may not be complete — verify against actual test implementations
BYO load test ipns-publish latency measurement may not be accurate since createAndPublishIpnsRecord() includes crypto operations not present in the original raw API call intent
The new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint has no rate limiting or audit logging for the BYO status change
